motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of November 12, 2025, Planning Commission meeting with 2 corrections, that…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to approve the minutes of November 12, 2025, Planning Commission meeting with 2 corrections, that the Policy Session start time is changed to the correct time and that on Item 7.A. Commissioner Fox’s vote is changed from “no” to “excused”. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion. Eagle Mountain Planning Commission Meeting – November 25, 2025 Page 1 of 7
motions.outcome: passed with 4 yes and 1 abstention vote.
motions.headline: November 12 minutes approved with two fixes
motions.summary: The commission approved its November 12, 2025 minutes after correcting the policy session start time and recording Commissioner Fox as excused, not voting no, on Item 7.A.
motions.impact: This fixes the commission's own record. You will not notice it.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Master Site Plan - Firefly NPA 9 Phase A,…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Master Site Plan - Firefly NPA 9 Phase A, with the noted recommendations from Staff included in the Agenda. Commissioner Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Firefly NPA 9 Phase A master site plan
motions.summary: The commission recommended the master site plan for Firefly NPA 9 Phase A to the City Council, with staff's recommendations included.
motions.impact: This plan goes to the City Council next. Until the council acts, it changes nothing on the ground in Firefly.

motions.item_title: Approve Item 7.B., Firefly NPA 9 Phase A Preliminary Plat, with the noted recommendations from…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to approve Item 7.B., Firefly NPA 9 Phase A Preliminary Plat, with the noted recommendations from Staff included in the Agenda. Commissioner Fox seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Firefly NPA 9 Phase A lot layout approved
motions.summary: The commission approved the preliminary plat for Firefly NPA 9 Phase A, the early lot-and-street layout, with staff's recommendations attached.
motions.impact: The developer can move this phase of Firefly toward a final plat. People living near Firefly are the ones who will see the result.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.C., Spring Run Plaza MDP and Rezone, with righ…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.C., Spring Run Plaza MDP and Rezone, with rights-of-way containing roads A and B, be rezoned as agriculture. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Spring Run Plaza development plan and zoning change
motions.summary: The commission recommended the Spring Run Plaza master development plan and zoning change, with the land under roads A and B zoned as agriculture.
motions.impact: This sets the outline for how Spring Run Plaza can be built. The City Council makes the final call, so nothing is built on the strength of this vote.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., Ordinance Amending Noticing Requirements i…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., Ordinance Amending Noticing Requirements in EMMC 16.05, 16.55, and 17.05. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Change the rules for public notice of land-use items
motions.summary: The commission recommended an ordinance changing the notice requirements in three chapters of city code, 16.05, 16.55 and 17.05.
motions.impact: These rules govern how people hear about land-use proposals. The record does not say what changes, and the council still has to adopt it.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.E., White Hills Rezone, with the Staff conditi…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.E., White Hills Rezone, with the Staff condition as noted and changing parcels in White Hills County Estates A to RA2, and J & J Ranches be changed to Agriculture. Commissioner Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Rezone parcels in White Hills
motions.summary: The commission recommended the White Hills zoning change with staff's condition, moving White Hills County Estates A parcels to RA2 and J & J Ranches to agriculture.
motions.impact: If you own property in White Hills County Estates A or J & J Ranches, this changes your zoning label. Nothing takes effect until the City Council votes.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.F., Amending the General Plan for Eagle Mounta…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.F., Amending the General Plan for Eagle Mountain's Annexation Policy Declaration, with the recommendation of extending Area 1 to Utah Lake. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Extend the annexation map's Area 1 to Utah Lake
motions.summary: The commission recommended amending the general plan's annexation policy declaration so that Area 1 reaches Utah Lake.
motions.impact: The policy marks land the city might consider taking in later. It does not annex any land itself, and the City Council has not yet voted on the change.
